description: This file defines a test factory class for setting up an in-memory database environment with Postgres containers for testing the DataAssetBackend API. It manages container lifecycle, configuration injection, migration application, and provides authenticated test clients.

classes.name: DbTestAppFactory
classes.description: A test factory for creating a WebApplication host that runs with a temporary Postgres container, applies migrations, and provides methods for authenticated clients during tests. Implements IAsyncLifetime to manage setup and teardown.

methods.name: CreateAuthedClient
methods.description: Creates an HttpClient with Authorization header and correlation ID set, for testing authenticated endpoints.

methods.name: ConfigureWebHost
methods.description: Overrides the web host configuration to set environment, replace database connection factory, and inject connection string into configuration.

methods.name: InitializeAsync
methods.description: Starts the Postgres container, constructs the connection string, applies database migrations, and obtains a JWT token for testing.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Disposes of the Postgres container after tests complete.

methods.name: ApplyMigrationsAsync
methods.description: Reads SQL migration files from the project, and executes them sequentially to set up the database schema.
